import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int MAX_N = 205;
    static int MAX_M = MAX_N * MAX_N;
    
    static int[] prev_edge = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] visited_node = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] head_node = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] edge_src = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] edge_cap = new int[MAX_M];
    static int[] edge_dst = new int[MAX_M];
    static int edge_cnt = 0;
    
    static int[][] grid_in = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] grid_out = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] red_flag = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] block_flag = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    
    static int[][] dist_table = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[] dist_red = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] visited_bfs = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[][] queue_bfs = new int[MAX_N][2];
    
    static int[] dX = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static int[] dY = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    
    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int uv_cap, int vu_cap) {
        edge_src[edge_cnt] = u;
        edge_dst[edge_cnt] = v;
        edge_cap[edge_cnt] = uv_cap;
        prev_edge[edge_cnt] = head_node[u];
        head_node[u] = edge_cnt++;
        
        edge_src[edge_cnt] = v;
        edge_dst[edge_cnt] = u;
        edge_cap[edge_cnt] = vu_cap;
        prev_edge[edge_cnt] = head_node[v];
        head_node[v] = edge_cnt++;
    }
    
    static int dfs_flow(int v, int t, int f) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        if (visited_node[v] != 0) return 0;
        visited_node[v]++;
        for (int e = head_node[v]; e != -1; e = prev_edge[e]) {
            if (edge_cap[e] > 0) {
                int u = edge_dst[e];
                int flow = dfs_flow(u, t, Math.min(f, edge_cap[e]));
                if (flow > 0) {
                    edge_cap[e] -= flow;
                    edge_cap[e ^ 1] += flow;
                    return flow;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int compute_flow(int s, int t) {
        int total = 0;
        for (;;) {
            Arrays.fill(visited_node, 0);
            int delta = dfs_flow(s, t, 2000000000);
            total += delta;
            if (delta == 0) break;
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int dt = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        Arrays.fill(head_node, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_table[i], 63);
            dist_table[i][i] = 0;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') block_flag[i][j] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z') red_flag[i][j] = 1;
                else grid_in[i][j] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    grid_out[i][j] = c - '0';
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = i + dX[d];
                        int ny = j + dY[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                            block_flag[nx][ny] == 0 && red_flag[nx][ny] == 0) {
                            dist_table[i * n + j][nx * n + ny] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int total_nodes = n * n;
        for (int k = 0; k < total_nodes; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < total_nodes; j++) {
                    if (dist_table[i][k] + dist_table[k][j] < dist_table[i][j]) {
                        dist_table[i][j] = dist_table[i][k] + dist_table[k][j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int qh = 0, qt = 0;
        Arrays.fill(dist_red, 63);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red_flag[i][j] == 1) {
                    queue_bfs[qt][0] = i;
                    queue_bfs[qt][1] = j;
                    qt++;
                    dist_red[i * n + j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (qh != qt) {
            int x = queue_bfs[qh][0];
            int y = queue_bfs[qh][1];
            qh++;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dX[d];
                int ny = y + dY[d];
                int nid = nx * n + ny;
                if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                    block_flag[nx][ny] == 0 && red_flag[nx][ny] == 0 && 
                    dist_red[nid] > 1e9) {
                    dist_red[nid] = dist_red[x * n + y] + 1;
                    queue_bfs[qt][0] = nx;
                    queue_bfs[qt][1] = ny;
                    qt++;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int sink_node = MAX_N - 1;
        int source_node = MAX_N - 2;
        
        for (int start_node = 0; start_node < total_nodes; start_node++) {
            Arrays.fill(visited_bfs, 0);
            qh = 0;
            qt = 0;
            int sx = start_node / n;
            int sy = start_node % n;
            if (block_flag[sx][sy] == 1 || red_flag[sx][sy] == 1) continue;
            
            queue_bfs[qt][0] = sx;
            queue_bfs[qt][1] = sy;
            qt++;
            visited_bfs[start_node] = 1;
            
            while (qh != qt) {
                int x = queue_bfs[qh][0];
                int y = queue_bfs[qh][1];
                qh++;
                
                if (dist_table[start_node][x * n + y] <= dt) {
                    add_edge(start_node << 1, (x * n + y) << 1 | 1, 1000, 0);
                }
                
                if (dist_table[start_node][x * n + y] == dist_red[x * n + y]) continue;
                
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nx = x + dX[d];
                    int ny = y + dY[d];
                    int nid = nx * n + ny;
                    if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && 
                        block_flag[nx][ny] == 0 && red_flag[nx][ny] == 0 && 
                        dist_table[start_node][nid] <= dist_red[nid] && 
                        dist_table[start_node][nid] <= dt && 
                        dist_table[start_node][nid] > dist_table[start_node][x * n + y] && 
                        visited_bfs[nid] == 0) {
                        queue_bfs[qt][0] = nx;
                        queue_bfs[qt][1] = ny;
                        qt++;
                        visited_bfs[nid] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
            add_edge(source_node, i << 1, grid_in[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
            add_edge((i << 1) | 1, sink_node, grid_out[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }
        
        System.out.println(compute_flow(source_node, sink_node));
    }
}
